history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man in a dark puffer jacket and dark pants stands triumphantly on the edge of a rocky cliff at the summit of a mountain. He is holding a green sign that reads "MT. TALANG 2597 MDPL". The man is giving a thumbs-up gesture with his left hand. In front of him on the rock are several scattered papers, some of which appear to be informational flyers or signs.

The background is a breathtaking panoramic view of mountains and valleys shrouded in a sea of mist, with a calm lake or body of water winding through the landscape. The sky is a gradient of soft blues and oranges, indicating either sunrise or sunset, with wispy clouds scattered across it. The lighting is soft and atmospheric, casting a warm glow on the scene. The overall mood is one of accomplishment, serenity, and the beauty of nature. The color palette is dominated by the cool blues of the sky and mist, the warm oranges of the horizon, and the deep greens of the distant landscape, contrasted with the dark clothing of the man. The style is realistic, capturing the grandeur of the mountain landscape and the human element of reaching the summit.
